title: Digital Marketing Assistant
description:
Digital Marketing Assistant - York

Brooklyn Recruitment are currently working with a well established yet rapidly expanding abrasives tooling business. They are looking for a Digital Marketing Assistant to be office based in the York area. This is a brand new role to the business so is a great opportunity to really make it your own.

As Digital Marketing Assistant your role will be extremely varied, and your duties will include:
- Planning and executing digital marketing campaigns.
- Managing the social media channels.
- Creating social media posts and videos.
- Designing email campaigns.
- Updating the website.
- Ensuring the brand values are highlighted and all items are kept on brand.
- Assisting other members of the marketing team.
- Maintaining the marketing library.
- Other duties as required

As Digital Marketing Assistant, you will be rewarded with a generous salary, a pension scheme, 25 days holiday, a great team environment and a chance to really shape the digital marketing role.

The hours of work for this role of Digital Marketing Assistant are Mon - Fri 9am - 5pm.

To be suitable for this role of Digital Marketing Assistant you should have previous experience in a similar Marketing position, ideally from a tool / construction / DIY background, but all industries will be considered.

You should have great communication and organisational skills as well as having extensive social media experience. You should also hold a degree in Marketing or another Business related subject or alternatively have real life experience. Instagram is currently the main social media channel used but they would also like to branch out into TikTok and to further utilise Meta.

title: Ecommerce Website Specialist
description:
Ecommerce Website Specialist

Location: Near York (Office Based), North Yorkshire YO60

Salary: £28,000 - £35,000 per annum DOE

Hours: Full Time, 37.5 hours per week

Commutable from York, Haxby, New Earswick, Huntington, Malton, Sheriff Hutton, Sutton on the Forest, North Yorkshire

Ready to Take Ownership of a Growing Ecommerce Brand?

Do you enjoy seeing the direct impact of your marketing efforts? Are you passionate about Shopify, SEO, PPC and turning website visitors into loyal customers?

Hawk 3 Talent Solutions are looking for a Shopify & Ecommerce Website Specialist to take ownership of an established ecommerce website, driving digital growth, and enhancing the online customer experience.

This is an opportunity to do far more than simply maintain campaigns. You'll have the freedom to test new ideas, improve performance, influence strategy, and see the results of your work every day.

If you're commercially minded, data-driven and enjoy finding innovative ways to increase traffic, improve conversions and maximise ROI, we'd love to hear from you.

The Role

You'll play a key role in driving ecommerce performance and digital growth by:
- Taking ownership of a Shopify website, continually improving the customer journey, and increasing conversion rates.
- Developing and implementing SEO strategies across technical, on-page and off-page optimisation.
- Managing Google Shopping campaigns to maximise visibility and online sales.
- Running and optimising PPC campaigns to deliver strong ROI.
- Creating and managing Google Ads and Meta (Facebook) advertising campaigns.
- Monitoring website performance through Google Analytics and other reporting tools.
- Analysing customer behaviour, campaign performance, and website data to identify opportunities for growth.
- Supporting new product launches, promotional campaigns, and seasonal activity.
- Keeping up to date with ecommerce trends, SEO developments, and digital marketing best practice.

Skills & Experience Required
- Proven experience managing and optimising Shopify websites.
- Strong SEO knowledge with a demonstrable track record of increasing organic traffic.
- Experience running Google Ads, Google Shopping and PPC campaigns.
- Experience managing Meta (Facebook) advertising campaigns.
- Strong analytical skills with experience using Google Analytics and reporting tools.
- Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- A proactive, commercially focused approach and a passion for continuous improvement.

Desirable
- Experience creating digital assets using Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar design tools.
- Knowledge of Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO).
- Experience using AI marketing tools and automation platforms.

What's on Offer
- Competitive salary of £28,000 - £35,000 depending on experience.
- Private medical cover.
- Employee Assistance Programme.
- Life assurance.
- Long-term income protection.
- Enhanced family-friendly policies.
- Employee discount scheme.
- Cycle to Work Scheme.
- Health and wellbeing support.
- Free on-site parking.
- Company events and social activities.
- 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.
- Additional holiday entitlement linked to length of service.
- Paid volunteering day.
- Flexible start and finish times.

Working Hours & Location

This is a full-time, office-based position located near York.

Working hours are flexible between:
- Start: 8:00am - 9:30am
- Finish: 4:00pm - 5:30pm

Applicants will require their own transport due to the office location.

Requirements
- Minimum 1 year's Shopify experience.
- Full UK Driving Licence.
- Right to work in the UK.
- Ability to reliably commute to the York area.

If you're looking for an opportunity where you can take ownership of digital performance, influence ecommerce strategy and make a measurable impact within a growing business, we'd love to hear from you

If you would like to apply for the role of Ecommerce, then please email your CV.

Closing date is 9.12.2026 Please note this could change subject to suitable applications.

Hawk 3 Talent Solutions are acting as an employment agency on behalf of its client.

By applying for the above position and providing your personal data to us you understand that your data will be processed in line with our Privacy Policy. To view our full Privacy Policy please visit our website.

Hawk 3 Talent Solutions are committed to the selection, recruitment, and development of the best people, basing judgements solely on suitability for the job. Whilst we endeavour to respond to all applications individually, due to high volumes, this is not always possible. Thank you for your interest in this role and we look forward to working with you in the future

title: Ecommerce/Shopify Executive
description:
Shopify and Ecommerce Specialist
- Job Type: Full-time
- Location: North York - Office Based
- Salary:£28,000 - £35,000 per year
- Working Pattern: Office-based, 37.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday

We are recruiting for an Ecommerce Specialist to take ownership of our clients growing Shopify website and help drive online sales performance. This is an excellent opportunity for an Ecommerce Specialist with strong SEO, PPC and website optimisation experience who enjoys using data to improve traffic, conversion and ROI. The successful Ecommerce Specialist will play a key role in shaping the online customer journey and supporting wider digital growth.

- Develop and deliver SEO activity across technical, on-page and off-page optimisation

- Monitor website and campaign performance using Google Analytics and other reporting tools
- Analyse customer behaviour and performance data to identify opportunities for growth and conversion improvements
- Support product launches and promotional activity alongside internal teams
- Test new ideas, review results and make recommendations to improve digital performance
- Keep up to date with ecommerce trends, platform updates and digital marketing best practice

Required Skills & Qualifications
- Proven experience managing and optimising a Shopify website
- Strong SEO knowledge with a track record of growing organic traffic
- Experience running Google Ads, Google Shopping and PPC campaigns

- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively

Benefits
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

- Employee assistance programme and wellbeing support
- Paid volunteering day

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Job Title: Marketing Executive
Location: Knaresborough
Salary: £26,000 - £30,000 per annum
Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:30 am - 4:30 pm

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Marketing Executive to join an established organisation in Knaresborough. This is a fantastic opportunity for a creative and enthusiastic individual to play an important role in delivering engaging marketing activity, creating compelling content and supporting campaigns that make a genuine difference.

Working closely with an experienced Marketing Manager and the wider team, you will be involved in a varied mix of marketing activities including social media, email campaigns, website content, creative design, events and communications.

Responsibilities of Marketing Executive:
- Create engaging content for digital, social media, email and other marketing channels
- Support the planning and delivery of marketing campaigns
- Write and edit content, ensuring accuracy, quality and brand consistency
- Manage and update website content
- Help grow and maintain social media channels
- Support email marketing activity and monitor campaign performance
- Create marketing materials and digital assets using tools such as Canva and Adobe
- Support promotional activity around events, including attending events when required
- Assist with PR, communications and media activity
- Use marketing data and analytics to measure performance and identify opportunities for improvement
- Maintain brand consistency across all marketing communications
- Work collaboratively with colleagues, external contacts and creative partners
- Bring fresh ideas, creativity and enthusiasm to the wider marketing function

Skills & Experience:
- A genuine interest in marketing, content and communications
- Previous marketing experience or a relevant degree, although recent graduates are encouraged to apply
- Strong written communication skills and excellent attention to detail
- Confidence creating content for social media and digital channels
- An interest in design, branding and visual content
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities
- Willingness to learn new systems, platforms and ways of working
- Positive, proactive and collaborative approach
- Confidence in contributing creative ideas and taking initiative

In return, you will receive a competitive salary of £26,000 - £30,000 per annum, alongside the opportunity to develop your marketing skills across a varied and engaging role. You will join a supportive team where creativity and initiative are encouraged with the opportunity to see your ideas translated into real campaigns and communications that have a positive impact. title: Marketing Executive
description:
Are you a marketing executive looking for a new dynamic role within an established marketing and digital team in the North Yorkshire area?

Are you looking to work for a business that values its employees and customers alike? Would you like to work across the business and support the marketing ideas across different departments?

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with good all round generalist marketing experience who is eager to contribute ideas and take ownership of projects.

What the Marketing Executive job involves

You will play a crucial role in supporting the marketing team across a broad range of activities, helping to elevate the company's brand and engage with clients.
- Creating engaging content, including blog posts, web content, press releases and other written materials.
- Creating SEO / GEO optimised content.
- Support the wider team to implement the marketing strategy.
- Developing and implementing graphic design elements for various marketing collateral.
- Coordinating and attending events.
- Supporting and attending a variety of events, including sector-specific, networking, charity, and careers events.
- Collaborating with teams across the business to align marketing efforts with business objectives.
- Crafting compelling advertisements for PPC campaigns.
- Creating internal content for employees to see what the wider business is involved with.
- Working with external agencies to make sure that projects are on brand and of the high quality needed.

This is a fast-paced and varied role that requires an individual who can manage multiple priorities and is keen to immerse themselves in the business.

Skills required

We are looking for a candidate with proven all-round marketing experience who can hit the ground running. Ideal candidates will possess:
- Demonstrable generalist marketing experience.
- Experience in copy writing with strong attention to detail.
- Ability to create diverse content.
- A proactive and self-sufficient approach, with the ability to work independently.
- The ability to think creatively and develop new ideas.

Some digital marketing experience, such as PPC and SEO optimisation, would be highly advantageous to support the team's digital efforts and reduce reliance on a single digital specialist.

Other information
- Working full-time Monday to Friday
- 24 days holiday plus bank holidays
- Car Parking available
- Potential for flexible working / Hybrid working
- Other benefits are available
